lines.english: "Once more, from the same spot."
"…You're asking me what went wrong? Hm, I don't even feel like telling you."
"If I had to say, I suppose it's the whole thing."
"From the top!"
"You're completely useless… I heard you were the peerless up and coming pianist, young and full of promise, but this is so far from what I expected."
"Did you think you'd have it easy here in Paris because you succeeded back home? You think we're that easy to please?"
"You probably just invited a bunch of relatives to your faux-piano concert, and then got the wrong idea when they gave you massive applause."
"I've had enough! It's pointless to continue any further."
"Now I finally understand why Youko never allowed you to play concerto."
"I've never seen a pianist this self-absorbed. Our orchestra has no need for you."
"Haah…!"
I collapsed straight on the bed the moment I got out of the shower, too mentally and physically exhausted to even wipe down my body.
I lie down on it with my head facing down, not even caring about the water dripping down from my hair and skin to my sheets.
"I'll quit for sure! But first I have to beat the shit out of him."
With a great concert ahead, one I was looking so forward to, that was the impression I had of the first rehearsal.
It's been a week since I arrived in Paris…
Delay after delay on their part forced me to practice by myself until yesterday.
I left my mom in Vienna full of determination that I was going to succeed in Paris, but that hope was slashed before I even got the chance to play.
During those days, when there wasn't even a point to me being in Paris, the only thing that went up was my level of stress.
And today, when my long awaited meeting with the orchestra finally arrived…
Yet the three hour long rehearsal was made up of only me and the violinists.
What I got to hear was not the performance of an orchestra, but a storm of verbal abuse from the creepy conductor Franz or whatever his name was.
I didn't make a single mistake. In fact, it's not even a piece that requires that much skill.
But he still refused to give me a single thumbs up.
Thanks to that, we never made it to the end of the piece. Hell, we didn't even make it past the first measure.
And to make matters even worse…
"Emma-san? It's Kazusa speaking… How has Mom been since then?"
Mom hasn't been feeling well the past three days.
"I see… and no visitors allowed like before?"
I asked Emma-san to give Mom a visit every now and then in my place, but apparently no one's been allowed in since she got worse.
"What did the doctor say? …Yes, yes, I see."
There's nothing concrete about what is happening yet, but we do know that her condition is deteriorating, and that she's not been eating well.
"…Message? Okay, go ahead."
The only good news, or any news at all, was the message one of the nurses passed on to Emma-san.
The contents of the message…
"…Thank you. I'll call you tomorrow then."
"Don't come back to Vienna until the concert is over, no matter what."
"Make sure you make Cloture a success."
"A normal success won't do either. You'll have to deliver a performance so legendary it will send all European media into a craze."
"That's kind of harsh…"
Traces of my mom's strength still remained in those sentences.
That was my sole comfort.
But I still would've liked to talk to her.
It doesn't matter how weak my mom looks. Even if I'll feel like crying at the sight of the state she's in, I won't complain.
I want to talk to you, Mom…
"What the hell is up with that bastard!? He's not even seeing me as a human being, let alone a woman!"
"I told you, didn't I? That man turns into a different person when he's performing."
"He ignored thirty other people for a full three hours! Everyone was in the back playing cards…"
"Oh that's a normal sight for his orchestra. He only picks on the newcomers."
"I'm amazed anyone's willing to follow his lead…"
"He's a genius when it comes to conducting, after all. I mean, I discovered his talent myself."
"Genius or not, his personality is rotten. I've never had my piano performance dissed like that in my entire life."
"I sometimes say things like 'this is kinda boring' too, don't I?"
"This is completely different from your dry criticism, Mom. He's stubborn, unrelenting and condescending. He nitpicks everything from my personality to my life…"
"Oh, I can just imagine the scene… I wish I was there to see it."
"I'll end up hating the piano at this rate…"
"Huh? Does that mean you enjoy playing the piano? I always thought you only kept at it to get 'his' attention…"
"Shut up!"
For some reason, living in the Paris Integral Hotel suite reminds me of spending time with my mom.
I see… half a year ago in that country, the place my mom and I stayed in was also like this…
"Japan, huh…"
The performance that disgusting conductor called a "faux-concert."
Come to think of it, my motivation right now isn't all that different from then.
Is salvaging a small bit of hope from misery the only thing I am capable of? Misery born of the world's rejection of me.
…Am I even capable of that?
Let's say… the upcoming concert becomes a success. Will that save Mom?
Will my performance give her the hope she needs to live a long life?
Or will my performance make her let go, no longer having any lingering regrets left…
Can I say for certain that Cloture isn't the requiem Mom is waiting for?
Should I play it with all my might despite that? Should I do away with her lingering regrets? Should I give her everything I can give her?
"…This is ridiculous."
…As if. Even thinking about it is nothing but arrogance.
Because if things continue at this rate, I can't imagine the concert going even slightly well.
But what am I supposed to do about that…? I can't even complain to her outside of my own thoughts anymore.
Because the strong, light-hearted and all-accepting mom I know… now only exists in my own thoughts.
The real mom has changed. She cries all the time, and she reminisces about the past like an old woman… She's turned weak, like a regular person.
Will she ever return to her old self, I wonder…
Come to think of it…
Whenever I told old man Fluegel about mom, our views on her always clashed.
"The Youko you know, Kazusa, and the Youko I know are very different people."
"The Youko I knew was full of ambition, jealousy and strife. She was inexperienced, immature, rough and young enough to put you to shame, Kazusa."
"It was that personality thatーafter growing in both age and experienceーturned into the whimsical Youko we know today."
"So if you ask me, the Youko you take for granted is one that has already changed."
I realized something when he told me that. Even the mom I've taken for granted is really two different people.
The first Touma Youko was someone who truly didn't care about me when I was a child.
Someone who was completely uninterested in anything other than how much I excelled in playing the piano, almost like a recruiter.
And the second Touma Youko is someone who until recently, was the whimsical mother I loved so dearly.
"Change, growth and maturity. Don't ever mistake aging for decline."
"For human beings are bound to change."
"You're simply the one who's changing too little, Kazusa…"
Crap, I was dozing off for a second there.
I'll catch a cold if I fall asleep like this… That might actually get the contract terminated.
"Haah…"
Through my blurry vision, I catch a glimpse of the ceiling I've grown accustomed to the past few days.
The conversation I had with that teacher permeates my thoughts.
People are bound to change, huh.
Then I should play the piano, so that I can guide Mom into becoming the type of old woman I want her to be.
Just like how I played the piano to get away from him, and return him to her.
That's the best choice, right? I don't have any other choice, right…?
"Touma."
"Touma… hey… sorry to bother you, but I need you to wake up for a bit."
"…Hmm?"
Ah, that was… the first time and he and I…
He told me it was love at first sight.
He said that he was captivated by the sight of me fast asleep in the classroom.
Why would he wait five years to say that…? What an idiot.
"Speaking of which…"
"What is it now?"
"This is the first time you've spoken to me on your own, isn't it?"
"…You're just imagining things."
"Thank you."
"You're still crappy."
And that was the first time we ever talked to each other properly.
Despite the scorching heat, I went to school for no other reason than the unreliable intel that he might be there.
…What kind of moronic girl was I?
Doesn't that mean I've been in love ever since that time?
"Hey, Touma-san… don't you think we could be really good friends?"
"Not at all. And what makes you think we would?"
"Because… we have similar tastes."
"I have no idea what you're talking about."
"You sure?"
But she already knew by then.
She saw through my feelings before she even got to know me.
She was so sharp that it made me uncomfortable. She was so dangerous that it made me want to cry.
That's why I was able to accept her. We developed a type of relationship even more difficult than one-sided feelingsーfriendship.
"Let's go, then. Touma-san, Haruki-kun…
I'm sorry for pulling in such a huge audience, okay?"
"Whenever you act all arrogant like that, it just leaves me speechless… Come on, let's go, Kitahara!"
"Yeah! Don't make fun of me if I mess up the solo, you two!"
"I'll definitely make fun of you!"
"I'll point and laugh, no worries."
"You guys…"
And then we became three. We became irreplaceable friends.
Doing so would only invite pain and sadness. I knew that full well…
I knew someone had to lose, and I knew the winner couldn't get away without their share of pain either.
But I still couldn't resist that sweet allure. I just wanted friends… I was the same as her…
"That's…
That's not something I want to hear from my best friend's boyfriend!"
"Weren't you the one who left me first!? Weren't you the one who went to a place beyond my reach first!?"
"Eh…"
"Always keeping me at arm's length, but never letting me reach you. Wasn't that torture your idea!?"
Yes, I knew it would end up that way…
I backed away, but then I forced myself upon him. I broke the three of us. I made a mess of our irreplaceable friendship.
"Hey, Kitahara… I… really loved you, you know."
"Yeah…"
"I loved you so much, so when you were taken by Setsuna, it was so painful for me…"
"There, I said it… Setsuna, I'm so sorry. But this is fine, right…? Because he can only hear my voice… Because I'll never meet him again…"
That's how I tore it apart.
I hurt the person I loved. I hurt the person who was my friend. Then I ran away by myself…
If only I could've avoided the pain by doing so… Staying over here, forgetting about them…
"Haruki…!"
"…Huh? Oh, you're already here, Setsu…!?"
"Haruki…"
"Kazusa…?"
If only… after five whole years, I could've just forgotten about him.
People are bound to change… That's only natural, right? Then why am I…
"Ah, put more meat in there."
"I got it."
"Ah, I don't want any fish."
"…It's not good to be picky with your food."
"I don't want any cabbage either, or onions. Actually, don't put in any vegetables."
"…That would defeat the purpose of a stew. This dish exists to make people eat vegetables."
Why can't I live like my mom…? Why can't I live like a normal person?
Why am I able to fill five years worth of emptiness in a single day, by just sitting around the same dinner table?
"Do you swear it? Do you swear to make me your wife, Haruki?"
"Yeah… in sickness and in health…"
"For good times and the bad?"
"For richer and poorer."
"To love, honor, comfort, and support…"
"And until death do us part, I swear right here to dedicate myself to you…"
I kept on longing for him, and even though I knew that I shouldn't, what wasn't meant to be still came true…
That's why the final result was…
…Tell me, are you really going to see what lies ahead? Do you dare to look?
Am I stupid…? What's wrong with being happy in my dreams, at least?
What's wrong with rolling the credits right there…?
"Let go of me…"
"Let's part with a smile… Let's stop dragging each other along…"
"Haruki… you…"
"I'm not grasping your hand."
"Everything will be solved if you just pull your hand away. You'll be able to go anywhere."
"…Don't be a bully. I wanted you to let go of me."
"I don't want to."
"I just wanted you to… reject me…"
"How could I possibly do that…?"
"You bully…!"
"Who's being the bully…?"
"You idiot!"
"Again… who's being the idiot…?"
"Aaaaaaaaaah…!"
"…! Aa… auugh… N-No… Uaa…!"
I saw it through to the very end… when I really didn't want to.
"…Ug! H-Haaah… uah…!"
It was as if my life was flashing before my eyes.
The few hundred days of my life when our lives overlapped.
But to me, those days were like an eternity. They might as well have been half my life.
"Ha-Haha…"
I thought I finally managed to stop thinking about it… I desperately tried to keep it out of my mind until now…
We live in different worlds now. Even our hearts, and our homes are completely separate now.
He belongs to her now, yet…
"I'm such an idiot…"
I look at my phone contacts, and his number is of course no longer there. I had even erased him from the phone's memory.
…That means I'm living in reality right now. I'm not in Japan, I'm not back where I was half a year ago, or five years ago.
"Haruki…"
It's been six years since our first meeting, five years since our break up, and half a year since our second break up.
How do you expect me to change in half a year, when I couldn't even change in five…?
